description.value:
When you make an attack miss with the Shield spell, reduce damage to 0 with your Arcane Deflection, or successfully prevent a spell with Counterspell, you can magically retaliate as part of the same Reaction against the originator of the attack or damage if you can see it and it is within 120 feet of you.

The target has to make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failure it takes force damage equal to a number of D8s times your Proficiency.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also expend a level 2+ spell slot to regain a use of this feature.
